# Olivia’s Kitchen

> Private chef service by Olivia in Haifa and Northern Israel. Israeli, Italian and Caucasian menus for groups of 4 to 30 guests: family events, corporate events and evenings with friends.

## Facts
- Cuisines: Israeli, Italian, Caucasian. No pork. Kosher, kosher-style and non-kosher menus.
- Service: full service or cooking only; seated menu or buffet.
- Area: Haifa and Northern Israel.
- Contact: chef@olivia.kitchen, +972545055199 (phone and WhatsApp)
- Sitemap: https://olivia.kitchen/sitemap.xml
